(1) **Image 2** shows stronger, more realistic wall relief. The normal map adds clear depth to the surface texture, making the cracks, grain, and bumps look three-dimensional and catching the light dynamically, whereas Image 1 looks flatter and more like a simple painted-on pattern.

(2) **Yes**, the overall color scheme and map look are preserved. Both images share the exact same base colors, lighting conditions, geometry, and UI elements; only the surface shading/depth has changed.

(3) **No**, there are no rendering artifacts in image 2. There are no missing or black textures, no z-fighting (surface flickering), and the tiling repetition is identical to image 1. The upgrade appears clean and correctly applied.
